results.title: Why Seagate Stock Skyrocketed This Week
results.summary: Seagate stock up 24% this week after Q3 FY2026 earnings. Revenue $3.11B (+44.1% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $4.10 (beat by $0.60/17.1%). Eighth consecutive quarter of growth. AI hyperscaler demand drives nearline HDD, fully allocated through 2027.

results.title: Why Are Seagate (STX) Shares Soaring Today
results.summary: STX shares soaring on May 1 post-earnings beat. Large data centers now 80% of revenue. Q4 guidance: revenue ~$3.45B and EPS ~$5.

results.title: Seagate Technology Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
results.summary: Official Q3 FY2026 press release: revenue $3.11B, non-GAAP EPS $4.10, Q4 guidance $3.45B revenue and $5 EPS. Nearline capacity almost fully allocated through 2027.

results.title: Why Is Seagate (STX) Stock Soaring Today
results.summary: Post-earnings surge on April 29, 2026. Strong AI infrastructure buildout demand cited. Rosenblatt raised target to $500, BofA to $605.
